verdict.rationale: Granola's site says it 'uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot' and works with Zoom, Meet, Teams and other meeting apps, and a community user confirms it runs in the background on a Mac using the microphone. However, Granola documents a transparency feature that posts a message in the meeting chat when transcription starts. The evidence does not say whether that message is optional or on by default, which weakens the 'participants see nothing extra' part of the story. missing for 10: confirmation that the chat transparency message can be disabled, technical docs on device audio capture, independent hands-on confirmation that participants see nothing.
